maxDetourM.description: Largest detour, in metres, a candidate may have. Greater than 0.

maxCandidates.description: How many candidates a hint lists at most.

hintTtlSeconds.description: How long a hint stays valid, in seconds. Greater than 0 and at most 2147483647 (400 `invalid-policy` otherwise).

eligibleTaskTypes.description: The task types a hint may point at. Non-empty; a repeated type is accepted and collapses to one.

items.description: A task type an interleaving hint may point at.
items.title: TaskType

verticalWeight.description: Weight of the vertical distance in the rectilinear travel model. At least 0. Absent or null means the default 1.
